name: Rust Metal
description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the creature corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the creature is destroyed after dealing damage.
